## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Contract impact

- [ ] No schema, prompt, model, checkpoint, or persistence contract changes
- [ ] Contract changes are versioned and documented

## Evidence and safety

- [ ] Exact source-evidence lineage is preserved
- [ ] Fail-closed behavior is preserved or explicitly justified
- [ ] No catalogs, source-derived payloads, secrets, databases, or model weights are included

## Verification

- [ ] Ruff passes
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Package builds
- [ ] Synthetic dry-run passes when relevant

## Research reporting

List corpus policy, configuration/model revisions, metrics, and limitations for any
new benchmark claim.
